steps.description: A swift half-turn to the Left side (90 degrees), ending in Samapada with Tripataka held high in the right hand.
steps.teaching_note: Focus on spotting (head turning last) to maintain balance and achieve a clean, sharp landing in Samapada.

steps.description: Hold the static Samapada pose facing Left for four beats, maintaining a straight, stable body line.
steps.teaching_note: Engage the core and check alignment: straight back, relaxed shoulders, eyes focused straight ahead in the new direction.

steps.description: Execute two controlled backward steps (R-L) maintaining the alignment, still facing Left.
steps.teaching_note: Ensure the steps are even and close to the ground; avoid lifting the knees or rocking the torso during the backward motion.
